I should check if the screenshot file has been created before the timeout occurs. I can look in the .tmp directory for any PNG files. Let's see what’s there and list the files to see if the screenshot is present. This way, I can determine whether the issue lies in the screenshot not being generated at all or if it's taking too long to create. I'll move forward with that check!
